title: crepis newii subsp. oliveriana
intro: Crepis newii subsp. oliveriana, commonly known as Oliver's hawk's beard, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which are attributed to its health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of Oliver's hawk's beard include wound healing, pain relief, and immune system stimulation, which are thought to be due to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents and the therapeutic potential of this plant species.
